title: ChopperCheck aircraft-data attribution and alteration method
scope: This notice applies to adsb.lol-sourced aircraft data and ChopperCheck's database-derived aircraft additions. It does not apply other providers' licences to their data, relicense application code, or include private browser preferences or independent map/weather layers.
reuse: The adsb.lol data and ChopperCheck's database-derived aircraft additions are available under ODbL 1.0. Preserve source and licence notices and the applicable share-alike and access rights. No additional restrictions are imposed on those data rights.

publicData.selection: The response source field identifies the provider. This ODbL notice applies when source is adsb.lol.

alterationMethod.upstream: Query only the requested shared regions listed in activeFeed.regions, using each centre and a 250 NM radius.
alterationMethod.transport: Normalise the provider aircraft-array name to ac, preserve aircraft record fields and the provider timestamp, and add source/attribution metadata. Reject invalid provider timestamps, responses older than 45 seconds, and timestamps over 30 seconds ahead.
alterationMethod.serverFiltering: Require finite latitude/longitude, exclude emitter categories starting with C, type TWR, and records with seen_pos over 120 seconds.
alterationMethod.browserFiltering: Require coordinates within latitude/longitude bounds and a nonempty hex identifier. Exclude ground reports, ground-vehicle/tower categories, known non-aircraft transmitter identifiers and records without a valid nonnegative position age. Retain positions no older than 45 seconds. Deduplicate by hex.
alterationMethod.browserAdditions: Calculate observation time from the provider timestamp minus seen_pos; decode type names using the linked public lookup table; identify operators only from reported owner/callsign rules in the linked source; otherwise retain unknowns. Calculate great-circle distance and bearing to the chosen reference. Do not infer routes or departure/arrival times.
alterationMethod.prediction: For targets with reported speed and track and speed of at least 25 knots, estimate displacement from the original reported position for at most 10 seconds. Preserve original observation time and observed trail. Remove the target after 45 seconds without a position report.
alterationMethod.history: Keep up to 120 received trail points per aircraft, within the latest 20 minutes of the page session. Predictions do not add observed history.
alterationMethod.retention: Only the latest snapshot for each of the three regions and operational coordination/cooldown/usage counters are stored. No visitor-location or historical-flight database is maintained. Snapshots over 45 seconds old are not served.

status: The live backend tries adsb.fi first, with a strictly quota-limited authenticated adsb.lol backup. Source and attribution are included in every snapshot. Neither source guarantees complete reception or uninterrupted access.

activeFeed.name: adsb.fi
activeFeed.coverage: UK, Northern Ireland, Ireland and North Sea via three overlapping 250 NM regions, selected by the visible map area.
activeFeed.processing: Preserve provider fields and timestamps, filter invalid positions/ground transmitters, and use the same public browser decoding, expiry and prediction methods described below. The ODbL statements below do not apply to adsb.fi data.
activeFeed.refresh: On demand only. Each requested region is refreshed no more often than every five seconds. A global database lock spaces all upstream requests by at least 1.1 seconds after the previous query completes. Provider cooldowns and backup quotas are global across all regions and visitors. Hidden pages stop requesting updates. No scheduled background collection runs.
activeFeed.retention: Only the latest snapshot for each of the three regions and operational coordination/cooldown/usage counters are stored. No visitor-location or historical-flight database is maintained. Snapshots over 45 seconds old are not served.

backup.name: adsb.lol
backup.limits: Persistent UTC request counters stop below the issued key limits: 18/30s, 100/min, 900/hour, 900/day, 4500/week and 9000/month. Conservative local transfer caps are 900 MB/day and 3.6 GB/month. Errors count. Failed or interrupted transfers keep a conservative byte reservation. Provider Retry-After is also respected. These counters only cover this backend, not any external use of the key.

coastguardIdentification.UK: SRD (COASTGUARD) and SRG (BRITISH RESCUE), from CAA SARG Policy 130; https://www.caa.co.uk/publication/download/20508
coastguardIdentification.Ireland: CGI (COASTGUARD IRELAND), from FAA ICAO designators; https://www.faa.gov/air_traffic/publications/atpubs/cnt_html/chap3_section_1.html
coastguardIdentification.limitation: Callsign/operator identification does not confirm an active rescue mission. Aircraft category and physical rotary/fixed-wing type are separate.
